name: Term-spread regime
formula: m_avg(DGS10-DTB3); ARM if <0 for >=2 of 3 consecutive months; ESCALATE if re-steepens +50bp from trough after >=6m inversion
notes: false positives: 1966-67; 1998/2018 correctly no-fire

name: Credit trend & credit-equity divergence
formula: spread>200d MA AND spread>=126d_low+75bp WHILE SPX within 3% of 52w high (21d)
series_or_endpoint: BAA10YM primary history; BAMLH0A0HYM2 rolling 3y window (archive it)
notes: PAIR WITH S3 or S15 to kill 1998/2011/2015/2018 false fires; FRED ICE truncation flagged

name: SLOOS lending standards
formula: C&I net tightening: amber >+10 red >+20; CRE red >+30

name: Funding stress
formula: hist: TED z>2 (1y) AND >100bp for >=5d. modern: F10 composite (CP-Tbill; SOFR-IORB; ABCP 4wk delta)
notes: the 2007 anomaly; 1998+2023-local false fires filtered by S3/S15 pairing + breadth-of-stress rule

name: Breadth divergence composite
formula: 2 of 3: (a) cum A/D lower-high vs index 52w-high over >=126td; (b) %>200DMA<60% at 52w high; (c) new 52w lows>2.5% of issues on >=5 of 21td with index within 5% of high
notes: survivorship-safe forward only; historical cells literature-sourced

name: Concentration / equal-weight lag
formula: EW_minus_CW 126td relative return < -4% while SPX within 3% of high

name: Defensive rotation
formula: mean RS(XLP;XLU;healthcare) vs SPY 63td > +5% while SPX within 3% of high
notes: no sourced historical print - honest cell

name: Epicenter fracture
formula: leader:=sector/theme top trailing-2y RS. FIRE if leader -15% from its high AND <its 200DMA while SPX within 5% of its high
data_source: own universe / sector ETFs / French industries
notes: best cross-crash internal 3/3; 2023 banks false fire filtered by market-wide layer confirmation

name: Aggregate short interest
formula: detrended log aggregate SI (linear trend to date) z > +1.5 (12m)
notes: Rapach et al 2016 evidence class

name: Margin-debt blowoff & reversal
formula: fragility: YoY>+40%. trigger: first 3m decline from peak (as of publication date)
historical_verdict_2000: peak Mar-00 coincident; trigger ~Jun-Jul00 with 96% of decline remaining
notes: coincident confirmer with small lag - valuable because slow bears are long

name: Issuance quantity & quality
formula: equity leg: IPO count + mean first-day return in top decile (hist to date). credit leg: HY share of gross corp issuance top quintile
historical_verdict_2008: equity leg silent; HY leg = 05-07 boom
notes: two legs map to two bear paths

name: Insider breadth
formula: open-market sellers/(sellers+buyers) filer-count 3m avg z>+2 vs 3y; codes S vs P only; exclude exercise/tax codes
notes: pre-2002 lag was up to ~40 days - never backtest earlier with modern lag

name: Valuation gate
formula: CAPE percentile vs own history-to-date: amber 85-95th; red >95th. ERP check: 1/CAPE - 10y real
notes: gate scales exposure ceilings only; structurally blind to 2008-type

name: Vol-structure regime
formula: (a) 21d RV crosses top quartile of 2y w/ >=10d persistence while SPX<200DMA; (b) VIX futures front>second >=5d (2004+); (c) VIX-21dRV<0 persistent (complacency)
historical_verdict_2000: VXO 23-29 at top - no timing signal
historical_verdict_2008: futures inverted Aug-07; CONTANGO AT OCT PEAK
notes: X-layer; 1997/2010/2011/2018 fires are corrections

name: Credit-boom R-zone
formula: business leg: 3yD(nonfin business credit/GDP) top quintile AND 3y real equity return top quintile. household leg: same w/ household credit + real house prices
notes: GHSS 2022 mechanism (~40% crisis prob in R-zone)

name: PC ratio z
formula: z of 21d MA total & equity P/C vs 252d
data_source: Cboe daily page scrape + free files
notes: files end 2019-10-04; scrape after

name: VIX percentile
formula: VIX vs 504d percentile

name: VIX term slope
formula: (VIX3M-VIX)/VIX and futures front-second

name: Skew slope 25d RR
formula: 25-delta risk reversal + 10d-ATM slope 1m/3m constant maturity from chain snapshots
notes: thresholds unusable until ~1y of archive

name: IV-RV spread
formula: VIX - 21d realized vol
notes: carry conditions for hedge selection

name: Deep-OTM put OI delta
formula: 21d change in OI of puts <=25 delta 1-3m SPX/SPY
historical_verdict_2008: Chen-Joslin-Ni caveat: public demand historically followed crashes

name: Index vs single-stock vol
formula: VIX - mean(top50 constituent 1m ATM IV)

name: Implied correlation proxy
formula: Cboe COR1M/COR3M percentile or F7 identity

name: Gamma-regime proxy
formula: GEX-convention estimate from UW OI (assumption: customers long puts short calls - PRINT ASSUMPTION ON DIAL)
notes: never a standalone trigger

name: Funding gauge (modern S4)
formula: primary: 3m AA financial CP - 3m Tbill; secondary: SOFR position in IORB corridor; tertiary: ABCP 4wk delta. z vs 252d
series_or_endpoint: CP series TBD; SOFR; IORB; ABCOMP
